name: breeze-cleaner
description: A real macOS disk cleanup app. Scans safe-to-remove junk, large files, duplicates, app leftovers and photos, and removes them to the Trash (reversible).
author: Breeze

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Breeze scans your Desktop for large files, screenshots and photos to clean.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Breeze scans your Downloads for large files, duplicates and photos to clean.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Breeze scans your Documents for duplicate and similar photos.
extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Breeze finds duplicate and similar photos in your photo folders.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Breeze reads your login items to list startup apps.
